source_title: Saquon Barkley’s latest injury comments put Eagles fans on alert after another setback against the Cowboy - The Times of India
source_excerpt: Saquon Barkley came back from a two-game hamstring absence on Monday night, but his return ended up being short. The Eagles running back felt a back issue after his first carry against the Cowboys and could not finish the game, a 38-21 loss in Philadelphia. Barkley still ran for 62 yards and a touchdown on seven attempts. Afterward he spoke about his health with clear frustration. For Eagles fans, that gap is the worry. He also admitted he does not fully understand why it keeps happening. That honesty matters. When a player cannot explain the pattern, the people watching him cannot predict it either.
